      ORDER AS MODIFIED GRANTING MOTION TO CONSOLIDATE, SET SCHEDULE INTERIM

                                    COMPLAINTS
             Case 4:25-cv-02588-HSG            Document 29        Filed 05/20/25     Page 2 of 2




 1          IT IS HEREBY ORDERED as follows:

 2          1.        The seven related data breach actions filed before this court “The Related Actions”

 3   (Wright (25-cv-02588), Newson (25-cv-02597), Finley (25-cv-02637), Demmie (25-cv-02639), Diaz

 4   (25-cv-02652), Hines (25-cv-02751), and Aguilera (25-cv-02877) are hereby CONSOLIDATED

 5   pursuant to Fed. R. Civ. P. 42(a) into Case No. 4:25-cv-02588 (the “Consolidated Action”)

 6          2.        Wright v. Smart ERP Solutions, Inc., Civil Action No. 4:25-cv-02588, shall be the “Lead

 7   Case” of the Consolidated Action. All documents filed in the Consolidated Action shall be filed under

 8   the Lead Case number and should be captioned In re Smart ERP Solutions, Inc. Litigation.

 9          3.        The Clerk of Court is directed to administratively close the Newson, Finley, Demmie,

10   Diaz, Hines, and Aguilera actions.

11          4.        If any party believes a case that is filed in, or transferred to, this District should be

12   consolidated into this action, the party may file a Notice of Related Action pursuant to Northern District

13   of California Local Rule 3.12. The Court will then determine if the case is related and should be

14   consolidated.

15          5.        Defendant is hereby relieved of responding to the initial complaints filed in the Related

16   Actions.

17          6.        Any applications for the appointment of Plaintiffs’ Interim Lead Counsel pursuant to Fed.

18   R. Civ. P. 23(g) will be due within 10 calendar days from the date on which this order is entered.

19          7.        Plaintiffs’ Interim Lead Counsel shall file a single consolidated complaint within 45 days

20   after the Court appoints them as such. Within 10 days after the consolidated complaint is filed, the parties

21   shall submit an agreed upon briefing schedule to the Court for motion to dismiss briefing or the filing

22   of an answer to the consolidated complaint.

23          8.        The initial case management conference scheduled for July 1, 2025, is hereby vacated and

24   will be reset.

25

26 Dated:        5/20/2025
                                                    HON. HAYWOOD S. GILLIAM JR.
